english: “And what of the part in the same text where it states that a belief that objects held by the mind exist in truth is an obstacle to knowledge? For it says— Those of the negative emotions And of the objects of knowledge Wither away through the use Of three different paths; Therefore the purity Of students who are rhinoceroses And those who are children Of the Buddhas…”
